oneLineDescription: Home shows net worth, a wallet strip that swipes across every account, and the Wallets page with one line per wallet.

beats.what: Wallet strip slides across to Cash, Wise USD and New wallet
Strip rests at Wise USD and New wallet
Wallet strip swipes back to the first wallet
Net worth opens Wallets with the net worth chart
Chart splits into one line per wallet

oneLineDescription: The spending pace chart on Home scrubs under a finger and zooms between ranges.

beats.what: Finger scrubs across the spending pace line
Range zooms to 7 days
Range zooms out to 90 days
Range returns to this month
Daily view shows spend per day this month

oneLineDescription: Type a purchase in plain words to Moni and it drafts the transaction for one-tap approval.

beats.what: Ask box opens Moni chat
Sends "paid 6 ringgit parking at KLCC"
Draft card shows Parking KLCC, RM6.00
Approve adds it to the ledger

oneLineDescription: Scan a paper receipt and Moni reads the shop, items and total into a transaction to approve.

beats.what: Plus opens the capture chooser
Scan a receipt opens the scanner
Imports the receipt photo
The scanner straightens the receipt, then Next
Moni reads RM15.30 from Restoran Nasi Kandar Ali
Approve adds it to the ledger

oneLineDescription: Payments Moni caught from bank alerts, receipts and chat wait in a deck; swipe right to approve, left for not mine.

beats.what: Swipe right approves GRAB*FOOD
Swipe right approves Jaya Grocer
Swipe left marks the receipt not mine
Swipe right approves Parking KLCC from chat
All caught up: 3 approved, 1 not mine

oneLineDescription: Ask Moni a question about your money and it answers from your own ledger with a chart.

beats.what: Ask box opens Moni chat
Asks "How much on Transport this month"
Answer card shows Transport spend with its chart

oneLineDescription: The Budget tab breaks the month down by category; a category opens its own payments.

beats.what: Budget tab shows the month's spend ring
Scrolls to By category
Food & Dining opens its payments and total

oneLineDescription: Add a recurring bill in a few taps and it joins the bills list with a countdown to its due date.

beats.what: Budget tab
Scrolls to Bills
Add bill opens the amount page
Keys in RM129
Due date sheet
Picks the due day
Add bill RM129.00
Indah Water shows in Bills with days left

oneLineDescription: The Budget calendar heats each day by spend; tapping a day lists what you paid.

beats.what: Budget tab
Calendar view heats each day by spend
Day 16 lists its payments
Day 20, the heaviest day, lists its payments

oneLineDescription: Track who owes you; record a repayment and Moni shows what is still owed.

beats.what: Debts tab shows who owes you and who you owe
Aiman's debt page, RM150 for the Penang trip
Record repayment
Keys in RM50
Recorded RM50, Aiman still owes RM100

oneLineDescription: A map of where you spend, with the top places and filters by range.

beats.what: Scrolls Home to Where you spend
Opens the spending map
Range widens to All time
Sheet lifts to Top places

oneLineDescription: Search every transaction from the Activity tab; typing grab leaves only Grab rows.

beats.what: Activity lists every transaction
Types grab, only Grab rows remain
